ModMetaData.name: RimSynapse - Factions
ModMetaData.author: RimSynapse Team
ModMetaData.description:
Discord Community: https://discord.gg/eVBebZ2N9s Version: v0.7.0 (Target: RimWorld 1.6)
RimSynapse - Factions Official Wiki and Documentation: https://github.com/RimSynapse/Factions/wiki
Companion Mod for RimSynapse. REQUIRES Regions and Territories, and must load after it. Intercepts world generation to dynamically spawn cloned factions, establish geographic settlement territories, and generate deep LLM histories for the resulting empires and nations.
As of 0.7 this mod also owns the systems that decide what a faction is worth. Regions and Territories says what a world object is and where it may stand; Factions says what the faction holding it extracts, taxes, defends and looks like from outside: - Regional economy: production and taxation computed against Empire Refactored's own figures, scaled by how much of a region a faction actually holds. - Settlement size classification: tiers derived from population read through the territory layer, rather than from a mod-specific field. - Military reach and supply: how far a faction can project force, and where its border really is. - Published faction standing: holdings, provinces, tiles, population and top tier exposed as one counted value other mods can read.
--- Roadmap --- 0.6 - Agent and Tool Foundation: delivered in v0.6.0. 0.7 - Regions and Territories Compatibility: basic pass-through alongside Empire Refactored and World Domination. Territories set tax rates; the regular game mechanics are left alone. 0.8 - Demographics, News and Narrative Voice: regional ideology and new map overlays, a newspaper driven by what actually happens on the world map, Aura's own personality, and local text-to-speech. 0.9 - Factions and Living Societies: state ideologies, conversion and ideological spread, ideological sites and spies - building toward living NPC societies. 0.10 - Cross-Mod Capability Passes: bringing every module back together for another pass over what the whole set can do. These ship when they are ready - no dates.
--- Changelog --- v0.7.0 - Regions and Territories Compatibility - NEW - Regional economy: production and taxation computed against Empire's own figures, scaled by how much of a region a faction actually holds. - NEW - Settlement size classification, military reach and supply, and a published faction standing surface other mods can read. - IMPORTANT - Taxation is modelled but not yet connected to Empire's levy. Tithes are unaffected this release; the wiring lands in a later version. - IMPORTANT - Regions and Territories must load BEFORE Factions. Reversed, every Factions type silently disappears and the mod does nothing. RimWorld obeys the order in your mod list, not the declared dependency. - Fixed: Harmony debug output was shipped enabled, writing an IL dump to your desktop and slowing patching for every mod loaded after this one. v0.6.1 - Fixed: the in-game mod list showed v0.5.2 with no 0.6.0 notes; version and changelog now agree everywhere - Roadmap updated: 0.7 is Regions and Territories compatibility (groundwork for Factions, which will require Empire) v0.6.0 - Moves in step with RimSynapse Core v0.6.0 (Agent and Tool Foundation) - Requires Core v0.6.0; saves and settings carry over unchanged - In-game wiki guides updated; "MCP" renamed to game tools throughout v0.5.2 - Maintenance release, aligned with Core and Psychology fixes - Licence changed to PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 v0.4.0 - Updated to support RimSynapse Core v0.4.0 (Multi-provider routing and Image generation).
--- Compatibility Matrix --- - Royalty DLC: Compatible and Optional. Enables royal splinter houses and vassalage generation. - Ideology DLC: Compatible and Optional. Integrates holy wars and organically generated schisms. - Biotech DLC: Compatible and Optional. Enables entire factions composed of xenotype warmongers. - Anomaly DLC: Compatible and Optional. Generates hidden cult factions that worship the void. - RimSynapse - Psychology: Compatible and Optional. Made better with Psychology! Automatically generates deep psychological profiles, traits, and backstories for Faction Leaders. (https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3760830041) - RimSynapse - WorldNews: Compatible and Optional. Generates dynamic newspapers detailing your factions' histories, holy wars, and geopolitical shifts.
--- Requirements --- - RimSynapse - Core (Must be loaded before this mod) - RimSynapse - Regions and Territories (Must be loaded before this mod)
*** LOAD ORDER MATTERS, AND GETTING IT WRONG IS SILENT ***
Both requirements must appear ABOVE this mod in your mod list. This is not a preference. Factions is compiled against Regions and Territories, so if it loads first it cannot resolve its own types: it will sit in your mod list looking active while doing absolutely nothing - no world generation step, no faction behaviour, no settings that work.
RimWorld does not fix this for you. The loadAfter entries above only advise the in-game mod list; the order your ModsConfig.xml lists is the order that actually loads, and any tool that sorts your mod list alphabetically will produce the broken order, because "factions" sorts before "regions".
RimSynapse Core now detects this at startup and writes a plain-language error naming both mods, so if you are ever unsure, check the log.
